# Hotkeys.cc — Keyboard Shortcuts Reference

> A searchable, dark-mode keyboard shortcuts reference for 20+ applications across 4 categories.

## Products

### Operating Systems
- macOS: https://hotkeys.cc/#macos
- Microsoft Windows: https://hotkeys.cc/#microsoft-windows
- ChromeOS: https://hotkeys.cc/#chromeos
- Chromebooks: https://hotkeys.cc/#chromebooks

### Web Browsers
- Google Chrome: https://hotkeys.cc/#chrome
- Microsoft Edge: https://hotkeys.cc/#edge
- Mozilla Firefox: https://hotkeys.cc/#firefox
- Opera: https://hotkeys.cc/#opera
- Apple Safari: https://hotkeys.cc/#safari

### Utilities & Tools
- Neovim: https://hotkeys.cc/#neovim
- Vim: https://hotkeys.cc/#vim
- Visual Studio Code: https://hotkeys.cc/#visual-studio-code

### Productivity Software
- Adobe After Effects: https://hotkeys.cc/#after-effects
- Adobe Photoshop: https://hotkeys.cc/#photoshop
- Adobe Premiere Pro: https://hotkeys.cc/#premiere-pro
- Blender: https://hotkeys.cc/#blender
- Google Docs: https://hotkeys.cc/#google-docs
- Google Sheets: https://hotkeys.cc/#google-sheets
- Microsoft Excel: https://hotkeys.cc/#microsoft-excel
- Microsoft Word: https://hotkeys.cc/#microsoft-word

## Features
- Instant search across all shortcuts
- Dark/light theme toggle
- Keyboard-navigable tabs (arrow keys)
- Hover tooltips on key symbols
- Collapsible shortcut categories
- Responsive design (desktop, tablet, mobile)

## Key Features
- 20+ applications covered
- 900+ keyboard shortcuts
- Platform-specific shortcuts (Windows, macOS, ChromeOS)
- Cross-platform shortcuts (Vim, Neovim, Blender)
- Real-time filtering
- Zero dependencies — vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
